title: Install the repository engineering organization
objective: Create a persistent, cost-controlled, evidence-based multi-agent workflow using actual environment capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks and dashboard survive new sessions
Parallel writers require isolated worktrees and disjoint ownership
Model routing uses only detected choices

remediation: Validator now enforces the three-writer policy, canonical registered worktrees, unique branches/workspaces, ready dependencies, and semantic scope isolation
Milestones cannot enter READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE or DONE without Reviewer, QA, Supervisor, acceptance-package, and BOSS evidence
Task claim uniqueness, field types, blocker consistency, required organization files, and negative fixtures are enforced
Task type values, canonical populated acceptance packages, repository-root scope conflicts, and blocker dependency references are now enforced
Every acceptance section must contain substantive evidence; headings-only files are rejected
result.required_follow_up: None for ORG-001; application findings remain separate tasks.
